notes.title: A message from Dev Team
notes.content:
[p align="start"]Hello everyone,
We are Dev team of Microvolts: Recharged.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]On August 26, we rolled out a major update to the weapon system.[/p][p align="start"]Since then, we’ve carefully reviewed the many pieces of feedback you’ve shared. While our hope was that this update would serve as a refreshing step forward, we realize that the intentions behind these changes may not have been[/p][p align="start"]clearly conveyed. For that reason, we wanted to break our silence and provide a more detailed explanation of the decisions we made and the direction we’re aiming for.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]We hope that through this note, our intentions and long-term vision become clearer.[/p][p align="start"]
======================================[/p][p align="start"]
[b]1. Why we reworked the combat mechanics[/b][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]At the beginning of the game, we tried to maintain a traditional FPS-style combat system. However, this approach limited the unique weapon concepts that define Microvolts. We came to the conclusion that the previous system was not aligned with the game’s core identity.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]With this update, our goal has been to highlight the individuality of each weapon concept and allow players to experience a wider range of playstyles. Moving forward, we want combat to be more than just numbers on weapon stats. We want every weapon to bring unique effects, distinctive traits, and tactical possibilities, giving you the freedom to tune and strategize in your own way.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]2. Weapon types and concepts[/b][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]This update brings a big change to how each weapon type works. Our goal was to make the traits of each type clearer, so that players can choose weapons that match their preferred style.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Melee[/b] weapons give players the freedom to personalize their combat style, supported by core movement abilities.
● Mobility Type: High agility allows you to approach enemies quickly and excel in ambushes.
- Movement speed has enhanced than before  
● Range Type: Balanced performance and extended reach provide stable combat.
- Movement speed has slightly enhanced[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Rifles[/b] provide balanced capabilities for mid and short-range encounters, supporting multiple tactical choices.
● Precision Type: Zoom feature gives an advantage at mid-to-long range and supports team battles.
- Zoom performance is enhanced
● Rapid-Fire Type: Optimized for close combat with a fast rate of fire to continuously pressure enemies.
- Fire rate and reloading speed are enhanced.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Shotguns[/b] focus on fast, decisive strikes in close-range encounters, allowing players to control combat flow. 
● Auto Type: High fire rate for overwhelming opponents in close quarters.
- Reloading speed has been enhanced.
● Double-Tap Type: Delivers burst damage with two quick shots, excelling at suppression.
- Knockback effect has been enhanced.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Snipers[/b] are designed for dominance at long distances, giving players flexibility to fit their preferred approach.
● Auto Type: Prioritizes sustained output, enabling you to land consistent follow-up shots in mid-range duels with faster reload speed. 
● Zoom-Speed Type: High magnification and quick zoom for accurate long-range shots.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Gatlings[/b] shine in close-quarters chaos, giving players an edge against groups of enemies.
● Rapid-Fire Type: Provides consistent fast firing, quickly taking down enemies and excelling in close-range battles.
- Fire rate and spin-up speed have been enhanced. 
● Power Type: Offers strong attack power that can suppress foes and shift the battle rapidly.
- Damage and enemy knockback have been enhanced.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Bazookas[/b] are designed for controlled explosive impact, Bazookas expand tactical possibilities in mid- and long-range encounters.
● Burst Type: Focused on quick fire and successive hits, this type offers high efficiency in close and mid-range encounters.
- Fire rate and reloading speed have been enhanced.
● High-Speed Type: Features fast projectile speed and delivers solid performance with balanced mechanics.
- Missile speed and effective range have been enhanced.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]Grenades[/b] enhance battlefield strategy by creating dynamic and flexible combat scenarios.
● Direct-Impact Type: Explodes immediately on impact, specializing in fast firing and rapid response in combat.
- As explosion mechanics have been modified, both fire rate and reload speed have increased.
● Sticky Type: Attaches to surfaces and functions like a mine, offering strong power and wide tactical options.
- As explosion mechanics have been modified, its damage has increased.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]3. Looking ahead[/b][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Our future plans for MVR include expanding weapon customization and introducing more tuning variations so that every player can express their preferred combat style. We are also planning additional cosmetic options—such as glow effects, which many of you have requested—to provide a sense of visual satisfaction alongside gameplay improvements.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Most importantly, we want to emphasize that our focus is not only on balance numbers, but also on your actual play experiences. Your feedback will continue to guide us as we refine and improve the game.[/p][p align="start"]
======================================[/p][p align="start"]
We remain committed to building a game that you can enjoy through your feedback and participation.
Thank you for supporting Microvolts: Recharged.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Sincerely,
Microvolts: Recharged Development Team[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]※ p.s We are aware of the currently reported issues and are working to address them as quickly as possible. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.[/p]

notes.content:
CASUAL TPS 『MICROVOLTS : Recharged』
Battle with your own figure!

Hello players,

We know you’ve been eagerly awaiting the next update, and the wait is almost over! 
As announced in the newsletter, the new event mode <Psychic Heroes>, will be on live very soon.

Get ready to defeat your opponents with random abilities and weapons given upon respawn!
[b]<Psychic Heroes>[/b] will offer a more thrilling, strategic, and challenging experience than any battle you’ve played before, bringing you an exciting new challenge and tons of fun.

[b]Event mode will be available from the maintenance on December 24, 2024 to January 14, 2025![/b]
===================================================================
[h3][b][Psychic Heroes Mode Rules][/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42841026/c88b432562333872f9e3af6d0593687a019aa399.png[/img]

1. A player who reaches the target kill count first within the set time wins!

2. One psychic ability & one random weapon(including melee) will be given every time a player respawns.

[b]Psychic ability list:[/b]
• Heal 200 health per second
• +2,560 max health increase (based on the parts in use)
• +200 speed, double jump enabled for all weapon
• Gain +100 max health (up to +1000) and +20 movement speed (up to +200) per kill
• Regenerate +2 ammo per second (for the weapon held)
• +450 damage
• Spawn with berserk item: Immediately restore full health after usage, +200 speed, +1000 damage for 10 seconds
(Press “F” key to use)

3. For every 15 kills without dying, you will receive an additional random psychic ability and random ranged weapon.
※ No duplicate abilities or weapons will be given, and they will be instantly acquired without swapping weapons.

4. Defeating an enemy using a melee weapon will subtract 1 from their kill count.

5. When the remaining time is 3 minutes or less, all players' respawn time will be reduced to 1 second, and movement speed will increase by +200.
※ Health increases and movement speed are stackable

===================================================================
Plus, you'll have a better chance of collecting Christmas tree decorations in this mode!
Have fun and gather amazing rewards from the Winter Wonderland Festival.

Best regards,
MVR Team
